'''2004 Mystic Visions''' was a Star Wars CCG constructed tournament (July 2004). It is known from the decklists below, recovered from DeckTech posts and Players Committee forms. It was played at Mystic Visions 2004, a charity convention benefiting the Vigilant Fire Company #2 in Columbia, Pennsylvania, held at the fire company (10th & Mifflin Streets) from 30 July to 1 August 2004, in the convention's fourth year. [[Michael Carr]], the Players Committee's Tournament Advocate, announced the convention on the PC forum; admission was $10 a day or $25 for the weekend.<ref name="pcf-3515-48081">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=48081#48081 Mystic Visions Is Coming!  (Pennsylvania Charity Convention)], Michael Carr, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (25 June 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040901021945/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=51468%26amp Internet Archive]</ref>

== Event ==

The convention's Star Wars CCG events included a Mini-Open that qualified two players for the [[2004 World Championship|World Championships]], and the top finisher earned the right to help design a virtual card.<ref name="pcf-3515-48081" /> The winner of the Star Wars Open was to receive a box of [[Theed Palace]] and a working video game system with at least three games.<ref name="pcf-3515-49209">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=49209#49209 Mystic Visions Is Coming!  (Pennsylvania Charity Convention)], Michael Carr, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (8 July 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040901021945/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=51468%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> The convention also ran four-round "instant tournaments", started whenever enough players for a sanctioned event were available, with all Decipher games sanctioned at no extra cost; Star Wars CCG was among them,<ref name="pcf-3515-48081" /> and Young Jedi and Jedi Knights instant tournaments were added in July.<ref name="pcf-3515-49209" /> The first 50 entrants received a grab bag that included a hand-made Star Wars virtual card.<ref name="pcf-3515-49209" /> The convention hours were changed to Friday 1 pm – midnight, Saturday 9 am – midnight and Sunday 9 am – 2 pm.<ref name="pcf-3515-48367">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=48367#48367 Mystic Visions Is Coming!  (Pennsylvania Charity Convention)], Michael Carr, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (30 June 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040901021945/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=51468%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> The Saturday charity auction included a Star Wars CCG Light Side [[Death Star II]] uncut sheet and three boxes of Star Wars CCG commons and uncommons.<ref name="pcf-3515-50759">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=50759#50759 Mystic Visions Is Coming!  (Pennsylvania Charity Convention)], Michael Carr, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (22 July 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040901021945/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=51468%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> On Wednesday 28 July 2004 a warm-up Lord of the Rings and Star Wars CCG event was held at the Comic Store in Lancaster, Pennsylvania, in "the new Mount Doom and V-Set 7 environment".<ref name="pcf-3515-51468">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=51468#51468 Mystic Visions Is Coming!  (Pennsylvania Charity Convention)], Michael Carr, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (28 July 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040901021945/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=51468%26amp Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Original VS6]] (from the card pool legal on the event date)
* '''Site:''' Vigilant Fire Company #2, 10th & Mifflin Streets, Columbia, Pennsylvania<ref name="pcf-3515-48081" />
* '''Dates:''' July 2004 (convention 30 July – 1 August 2004)<ref name="pcf-3515-48081" />
